subject: Re: Re-onboarding MAP & new champion introduction — Avery Labs
messages:
From: Jordan Reeds <jordan.reeds@averylabs.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@averylabs.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Evaluating Redwood for Inference

Hi Dylan / Monica —

Quick update on our side: we paused the MAP in mid-July while we sorted a reorg on the ML team. I ended up moving to a product role and won’t be able to own the evaluation through to completion. I want to re-introduce Pamela Ortiz (cc'd) who will take point as the internal champion for Avery going forward.

Pamela — we’ve been working with Redwood on a short evaluation to validate latency and cost for our inference use case. The draft MAP we had includes: evaluation objectives, test dataset, perf targets (p99 < 200ms for typical queries), security checklist, and a two-week pilot window.

I’m handing this over to Pamela and will stay available for context, but Pamela will drive next steps and approvals. Dylan / Monica — can you confirm the latest MAP doc and any checklist items Pamela should expect?

Appreciate it —
Jordan
Product Manager, Avery Labs

Attachments: MAP-draft-July.xlsx (previous version)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan: Evaluating Redwood for Inference

Team — forwarding Jordan’s handoff. Pamela is the new champion. Quick internal plan:
- Monica: refresh the MAP to reflect the paused items and include a short "handoff" section for Pamela.
- Vivek: prepare an updated perf appendix with sequences and p99 numbers from the pilot runs (include cost estimates).
- Steph: update security/compliance checklist (SOC2 evidence pointers).

Goal: have an updated MAP and evaluation-rubric to share with Pamela by 24 Aug so we can schedule a re-kick the week of 31 Aug. If we can’t meet that date, push to first week Sep but I want to avoid a multi-month stall.

I’ll draft the external note once we have attachments. Keep this tight — they’re moving quickly on approvals.

— Dylan
AE, Redwood Inference

From: Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@averylabs.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Reeds <jordan.reeds@averylabs.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Evaluating Redwood for Inference

Thanks, Dylan & team — nice to meet you all (virtually).

A few ground rules from Avery procurement/ops side:
- We have a hard evaluation window we want completed before EOW Sep 17 so that our finance team can include any committed spend in the October planning cycle.
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC2, data retention, access logs) will be gating for Dedicated or Private. Please flag any gaps early.
- The evaluation should include a short quality rubric for outputs (precision/recall-ish checks) in addition to perf/cost.

Can you please send the refreshed MAP, an evaluation-rubric PDF, and the current SOW draft? Also propose a 60-minute re-kick meeting (I prefer Tue/Wed mornings PST).

I’ve attached a one-pager for context (evaluation-priority.pdf). Looking forward to a clear plan and owner alignment.

— Pamela Ortiz
Head of Vendor Evaluations, Avery Labs

Attachment: evaluation-priority.pdf (1 page)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reeds <jordan.reeds@averylabs.com>, Pamela Ortiz <pamela.ortiz@averylabs.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-onboarding MAP & new champion introduction — Avery Labs

Pamela / Jordan — thanks for the clarity and timeline. Re-kick below with requested artifacts and proposed timeline.

Attachments included:
- Avery-MAP-v2.xlsx (MAP with clear milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria)
- evaluation-rubric.pdf (short rubric for quality checks and pass/fail criteria)
- SOW-draft.docx (baseline SOW for pilot; redlines welcome)

Proposed re-kick timeline (compressed to hit your Sep 17 target):
1) Week of Sep 7: Re-kick meeting and finalize pilot scope (2 weeks)
2) Week of Sep 14: Pilot execution (can be extended by 1 week if required)
3) Week of Sep 21: Results review + decision (go/no-go or Dedicated sizing)

Owners and roles (MAP top-level):
- Pamela Ortiz (Avery) — Champion / final decision maker
- Jordan Reeds (Avery) — Product context & test dataset owner
- Dylan Brooks (Redwood) — Commercial lead / escalation
- Monica Patel (Redwood) — MAP owner / pilot run coordination
- Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — Benchmarks & perf appendix
- Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood) — Security/compliance touchpoints

Immediate asks for the re-kick meeting:
- Pamela: confirm Tue 8 Sep 10:00–11:00 AM PT or Wed 9 Sep 9:00–10:00 AM PT — which works?
- Pamela: confirm whether the pilot will run on sample_production_1 or sample_production_2 dataset (Jordan to advise)
- Jordan: share final test dataset link in Drive before the meeting

Links & records:
- MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Avery-Redwood-MAP
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/DL-2026-0893
- Draft SOW (DocuSign template): https://www.docusign.com/templates/avery-redwood-sow

We’ll also add a short meeting agenda in the calendar invite and include a 15-min buffer at the end for procurement Qs. Let me know which meeting slot you prefer and I’ll send the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the loop here.

— Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187

Dylan — thanks, the timeline looks fine. Let’s take Tue 8 Sep 10:00–11:00 AM PT for the re-kick. Jordan — I’ll confirm dataset by EOD Monday.

A couple quick notes before the meeting:
- Please ensure the evaluation-rubric includes a short example of expected outputs for 3 sample prompts (we’ll use that for quality checks).
- We prefer the pilot to run in your hosted sandbox first; if we need Dedicated we’ll discuss sizing after results.

I’ll accept the invite when it appears.
